1978 - 1989

1990 - 1999

  • 1997: Achieved ISO 9002 certification.
  • 1998: Continued efforts to improve quality through ISO 9002 processes.

In October, GPI developed precision gears with a 60mm outside diameter for copiers and began mass production.

2000 - 2009
#

  • 2000: The company name was officially changed to General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. in April. In May, GPI issued stocks, and by August, total capital increased to 9.7 million USD.

  • 2002: In April, mass production began for the first model of complex “All in one” laser printer toner cartridges, with several additional models developed.
